Application Data.NAME: Greenway Cleaners
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Greenway Cleaners specializes in providing professional dry cleaning and laundry services to both residential and commercial clients. Our operations include the use of environmentally friendly cleaning solvents, efficient equipment for garment care, and rigorous safety protocols to ensure compliance with local regulations. We also offer stain removal, alteration services, and pick-up/delivery options, all while prioritizing the health and safety of our employees and customers. Our facility is equipped with state-of-the-art technology to minimize environmental impact and enhance operational efficiency.

Key Risk Considerations
Dry cleaning and laundry services face several unique risks that must
be carefully evaluated:
• Fire and Explosion Hazards: Dry cleaning fluids such as perchloroethylene and petroleum-
based solvents are highly flammable or volatile.
Heat presses and steam equipment also
present ignition sources. Poor ventilation or faulty electrical wiring can exacerbate fire risk.
For example, a fire originating from a malfunctioning heat press could quickly spread due to
solvent vapors.
• Chemical Exposure and Pollution Liability: Improper handling or disposal of solvents
can lead to environmental contamination, groundwater pollution, or employee health claims.
Industrial laundries using harsh chemicals must have documented safety protocols and spill
containment measures.
